metadata.title: Coinbase Stock, Robinhood, Strategy Jump—and They’re Set for More Crypto Gains<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Coinbase, Robinhood, Strategy Jump—and They’re Set for More Crypto Gains
Coinbase and other crypto-linked stocks were surging again on Thursday after President Donald Trump urged for Congress to pass digital asset legislation, sparking a rally in Bitcoin and other tokens.
